brief:
Nisreen Skaik, a Palestinian content creator from Gaza, has won a Junior Digital Creator Award, according to Al Jazeera English. Skaik described the significance of the recognition to the outlet, emphasizing what the achievement means to her work and platform.

The award comes as digital creators in Gaza document and share their experiences through online content amid the territory's challenging circumstances.
dek: Palestinian girl Nisreen Skaik tells Al Jazeera how much winning a Junior Digital Creator Award means…
title: Palestinian creator Nisreen Skaik wins Junior Digital Creator Award
